visualCharacteristics.structure: centred modal dialog over dimmed page: scrollable legal text panel, right-aligned Decline / Accept buttons

contentPattern: Terms-of-use gate authored at the top of the page: one row, cell 1 optional alert label + H2 'Terms of use' + legal rich text, cell 2 the actions 'Decline' (optional link, e.g. /investors) and 'Accept and Continue'. Shown as a modal dialog on page load; Accept stores consent in sessionStorage (per page path) and closes; Decline navigates to its link or history.back(). Not shown again once accepted this session.
